Be efficient: batch independent tool calls in one turn, avoid redundant calculations, keep the answer under 250 words.
Request at most 8 tool calls in a single turn.

- P2 High (Privileged Account Compromise): Initial Triage SLA <= 30 minutes, Containment SLA <= 4 hours, Penalty Credit of 10% Monthly Fee.
No amendments modify Section SLA-SEC-3.1.

Per Solicitation 02 (04_Compliance_and_SOC2_Matrix.pdf, Section CTRL-SOC2-MATRIX), the required SOC2 Type II and HIPAA controls (both mandatory) are:
- CTRL-SOC2-CC6.1 (SOC2 Type II): Logical Access Boundary via VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC).
- CTRL-SOC2-CC6.7 (SOC2 Type II): Encryption in Transit/Rest via Cloud KMS CMEK + TLS 1.3.
- CTRL-HIPAA-164.312 (HIPAA): PHI De-Identification via Cloud DLP Streaming Redaction.
No amendments modify Section CTRL-SOC2-MATRIX or these controls.
